summary: Wrote an 8-phase plan (10.5h) correcting the 28 over-reporting 'Constraints consumed:' markers the research probe identified, leaving the 40 accurate sites untouched. Two of the report's recommendations were re-derived and corrected at plan time: taskRel_eq_iter_of_constraints already exists (so ConeUnravelling needs no new enabler twin), and C34a's delegates() predicate requires a delegate named in the row's OWN body, so each binder-carrying corrected site needs its own twin -- roughly 19 per-site twins plus 3 enabler twins, not 3 total. Path.lean's 20 sites are split across three phases and will cross its recorded longFile 1700 ceiling (1,554 lines today), stated with its escape valve rather than glossed.
